The instrument features a symmetrical facade with multiple ranks of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, creating a stepped silhouette. The central section contains the tallest pipes, flanked by shorter ranks on either side. The casing is elaborately carved wood with gilded details and decorative moldings. Below the main pipe array, there is a console area, though partially obscured by foreground elements (possibly candles or altar decorations). Two figures in white robes are visible at the bottom center, providing scale.
